# Baci

> Baci is an AI-powered e-commerce platform that enables merchants to build, manage, and grow their online stores in minutes. Create a fully functional store by describing your business, powered by Google Gemini AI.

Baci ("Your business, live in 3 minutes") is a modern e-commerce builder for African and global merchants. The platform uses AI to generate store layouts, product descriptions, logos, and optimize sales automatically.

## Core Features

- **AI Store Generation**: Create complete online stores in seconds by describing your business
- **Smart Product Management**: AI-generated descriptions, inventory tracking, variant management
- **Multi-Channel Selling**: Unified dashboard for online and physical sales
- **Integrated Payments**: Korapay, Paystack, Kuda, and Credit Direct support
- **Shipping Integration**: GIGL, Topship, and Shiip for Nigerian logistics
- **Business Analytics**: Real-time insights into sales, inventory, and performance
- **Customer Loyalty**: Built-in loyalty programs and customer engagement tools
